paragraphs.source_en: In a few moments, Porcupine stood up again and said, "Just now I forgot to say a little more; I left it unsaid, and I'll add it. It seems that the teacher on duty that night went out to take a bath at the hot spring. It was an act inexcusable for him to do. Was not he responsible as night watch for the care and safety of the whole school? But seeing there was nobody to stop him, he boldly went out and where do you think he went? Why, the hot spring was the destination of his deliberate choice. It was cen tainly a great blunder on his part. paragraphs.source_en: while on night duty. I thought it was the custom, and so I went out to the hot spring. Nov I saw by his remark that I was wrong and that I had no way to defend myself if attacked. Whereupon I stood up again and said that I was wrong to go out to the spring while on night watch; that I was very sorry and humbly begged pardon. On resuming my seat, I was greeted with a volley of laughter from the teachers. "You unworthy fellows!" said I to myself, "Can you frankly confess before the public that you have been wrong! You laugh because you cannot."
